notes: Suggested actions are starting points for a manager to judge. They are not findings from the reviews. Keyed by aspect key; 'default' is used for any aspect without its own entry. Texts must not contain digits.

default.complaint: Read the guest comments linked to this insight, confirm the cause on site, and agree an owner and a follow-up check.
default.strength: Find out what the team does well here and make sure it is written down and protected when staff or suppliers change.
default.opportunity: Compare the comments of satisfied and dissatisfied guests to see what differs, then test one small change.

cleanliness.complaint: Review the housekeeping checklist and room inspection routine, and spot-check the areas guests mention most.
cleanliness.strength: Keep the current housekeeping standards and inspection routine, and recognise the team.
cleanliness.opportunity: Check which rooms or areas are mentioned negatively and adjust inspection for those.

staff_service.complaint: Share the specific comments with the team, review staffing at the busiest times, and consider refresher guest-service training.
staff_service.strength: Recognise the staff mentioned by guests and keep the practices that earn this praise.
staff_service.opportunity: Look at when service is praised and when it is criticised to find gaps in cover or handovers.

location.complaint: Check whether guests lack clear directions, transport information or neighbourhood guidance, and add it to pre-arrival messages.
location.strength: Keep highlighting the location, with practical local tips, in listings and pre-arrival messages.
location.opportunity: Add short local guidance so guests who find the area less convenient know what to expect.

room_comfort.complaint: Inspect the beds, bedding, noise insulation and temperature control in the rooms guests mention, and plan maintenance or replacement.
room_comfort.strength: Protect the room standards guests value when planning refurbishments.
room_comfort.opportunity: Identify which rooms attract the complaints and prioritise those for maintenance.

facilities.complaint: Check the condition and availability of the facilities guests mention, and communicate any known limits clearly before arrival.
facilities.strength: Keep the facilities well maintained and mention them in listings.
facilities.opportunity: Check opening hours, upkeep and signage for the facilities where opinion is split.

food_breakfast.complaint: Review breakfast quality, replenishment and the serving schedule, and check how busy periods are handled.
food_breakfast.strength: Keep the breakfast offer and quality checks that guests value.
food_breakfast.opportunity: Look at timing, choice and replenishment to see what separates good breakfast experiences from poor ones.

value_for_money.complaint: Compare what guests expect for the price with what is delivered, and review pricing, inclusions or how the offer is described.
value_for_money.strength: Keep the balance of price and quality that guests recognise, and be careful with changes that could upset it.
value_for_money.opportunity: Check whether the listing sets the right expectations for the price.

wifi_connectivity.complaint: Test Wi-Fi coverage and speed in guest rooms, and check the equipment and the internet connection.
wifi_connectivity.strength: Keep the current network setup and test it regularly.
wifi_connectivity.opportunity: Test the connection in the rooms where guests report problems.
